answer: The issuer assigns 1,000 unique optimization tasks to each agent, where every jade logic module serves as a mandatory, non-replayable trace. An honest agent spends 1,000 units of work, but an attacker spawning 1,000 identities pays linearly more as no trellis output can be reused. A verifier probes the opal audit receipt for any error; if a failure is found, the node loses its stake. Work is non-parallelizable.
